mrl.coef_units: change in target per +1 SD of the feature (standardized ridge coefficient)
mrl.dataset: Sample et al. 2019 GEO GSE114002 / GSM4084997, varying-length (25-100 nt) eGFP library, total_reads >= 10: all 'human' 5' UTR fragments + random-library test split (top 100 by reads per length)
mrl.target: mean ribosome load (MRL, polysome profiling, HEK293T)
mrl.fold_method: ViennaRNA 2.8.0: punp = RNAplfold-style unpaired prob (pfl_fold_up u=1 W=150 L=100) on UTR+first 30 nt CDS; mfe = UTR MFE with max bp span 100; cap_dG = MFE of first 50 nt
mrl.leakage: Optimus varying-length model was trained on the random-library training split only; rows here are the human set and the random test split, so Optimus never saw them. Optimus architecture/hyperparameters were however chosen on this library.
mrl.applicability: trained on 25-100 nt UTR fragments in an eGFP reporter; per_isoform mrl_pred for longer endogenous UTRs extrapolates (length / uAUG counts beyond the training range)
mrl.physics_note: physics = app/src/analytic.js expected() at app default params, log(initiations/min); physics_fitted = 4 params refit per fold (see physics_fit)

te.coef_units: change in target per +1 SD of the feature (standardized ridge coefficient)
te.dataset: Cao et al. 2021 (Nat Commun) HEK293T transcript TE (Andreev 2015 Ribo-seq/RNA-seq), 5' UTR + CDS from GENCODE v19 pc_transcripts (exact versioned ID match)
te.filters: rnaseq_counts >= 50, riboseq_counts >= 10, te > 0, CDS starts ATG, 5' UTR >= 10 nt, no sibling isoform with bit-identical TE (unresolved quantification)
te.fold_method: ViennaRNA 2.8.0: punp = RNAplfold-style unpaired prob (pfl_fold_up u=1 W=150 L=100) on UTR+first 30 nt CDS; mfe = UTR MFE with max bp span 100; cap_dG = MFE of first 50 nt
te.leakage: none from Optimus (MPRA-trained). Ridge features/filters were not tuned on this set.
te.within_gene_note: pairs = same-gene isoforms with different 5' UTRs; out-of-fold predictions (gene held out); ctrl_longer_CDS = predicts the isoform with the longer CDS has higher TE (no 5' UTR information; flags isoform-quantification/length effects in the TE table)

physics_fit.dataset: Sample 2019 MRL rows used for models.mrl (same rows, same 5 folds)
physics_fit.note: score = log(initiations/min) from analytic.js expected(); linear map to MRL fit on training folds; Nelder-Mead (<=80 evals) from app defaults, params clipped to the app slider ranges; hairpins from a local MFE fold (max bp span 100); all other params at app defaults.
